aboutText: Based in Mickleham, Cabinets And Kitchen has delivered dream cabinetry to homeowners and businesses across Craigieburn, Glenroy, Roxburgh Park, Greenvale, Campbellfield, Coburg and Reservoir. With years of hands-on experience working with the finest materials the industry has to offer, we have an unrivalled proven track record of delivering exceptional indoor and outdoor kitchens, bathrooms, laundries and commercial fitouts. Our passion is turning your vision into beautifully crafted, functional cabinetry that stands the test of time.
servicesText: From Mickleham homes to commercial spaces across Melbourne's north, we design and build custom cabinets tailored to your exact needs. Every project uses premium materials and expert craftsmanship.

services.title: Kitchen Cabinets
services.desc: Custom indoor kitchen cabinetry designed for style and function, built with premium materials to transform your cooking space.

services.title: Outdoor Kitchen Cabinets
services.desc: Weather-resistant outdoor kitchen setups built tough for the Australian climate, perfect for entertaining in your backyard.

services.title: Bathroom Vanities
services.desc: Sleek, practical bathroom cabinetry and vanities tailored to maximise storage and elevate your bathroom's look.

services.title: Laundry Cabinets
services.desc: Smart laundry storage solutions that keep everything organised, with custom-fit cabinetry for even the tightest spaces.

services.title: Walk-in Robes & Cellars
services.desc: Bespoke walk-in robe and cellar storage systems designed to showcase your wardrobe or wine collection beautifully.

services.title: Commercial Cabinetry
services.desc: Offices, boardrooms and commercial storage built to professional standards, delivering functional workspaces across Melbourne's north.
